title: The Making of "Watercolor Warriors"
content: What would a reality show like "Watercolor Warriors" be without a behind-the-scenes special feature?(Video link) Here's a clip that didn't make it into the final production.At the Watercolor Warriors studio, we're always pushing the technical envelope to give you those sophisticated shots, like those slowly drifting tracking shots that you see in the high class productions. But as you can see, we're on a budget and we're working out the bugs.The biggest challenge is that the production team consists entirely of me. Besides painting, I'm also trying to multi-task as director, cameraman, audio recorder, and editor, since Jeanette would rather just keep life simple and just paint.-------See the Watercolor Warriors episode "Bees, Rain, and Wind"on the blogor onYouTube
